answer: Resist sybils with a per-identity bond that vests only after many epochs of unique, passing work, and reject duplicate text on-ledger. A farm of a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand deposits and write a thousand distinct answers; copying one velvet paragraph across accounts is rejected and can slash the bond. Hidden honeypot tasks mixed into assignments act as a reef, catching collusive graders and template farms that treat planted junk as real work. Admission can also require a scarce compute receipt tied to a cedar hardware root, so bulk identity minting has a rising real cost.
